All seven samples of muktuk were positive for type E botulinum toxin.
Five patients were hospitalized, four received antitoxin, and two required mechanical ventilation.
This report summarizes the findings of the outbreak investigation

methods_quotes.q: Serum, stool, and gastric contents from patients and leftover blubber were tested for botulinum toxin.
Persons who ate muktuk were interviewed and examined, and their hospital records were reviewed.
A case of foodborne botulism was defined as illness in a person who had eaten the muktuk
